description: Cross-validation fixture for the frequency-domain admittance solver. Generated by scripts/generate_crossvalidation.py in the SurfaceTemps repository, which is the canonical source. The Eddy3D C# port embeds a byte-identical copy and asserts the same expected values; if you regenerate this file you MUST copy it into Eddy3D/Radiance.Core/Resources/ or the two implementations will silently diverge.
